description: Selective body review covers S001, S004, S005, S044, S045 and S046. The UCR chronology was exposed through all 452 extracted lines across two overlapping reads, and five event-level news reports were read. Fifteen provisional action candidates and one Nicaragua-target exclusion are coded from this evidence: 14 remain pending_threshold and the Jan 14 Puerto Viejo/San José candidate remains pending_unit. S017 and S018 yielded no article body after technical retrieval failures. The S044–S046 cards are synchronized to their saved body-read outcomes. Forty other source cards remain unopened; no additional individual card was selected as a blocking material target for this scoped open-web pass. The documented open-web discovery and prioritized-source first pass is complete, pending independent review; this does not imply exhaustive coverage.
required_followup: Obtain independent review. Preserve the remaining attendance, date, demand, response, event-boundary and written-story-origin gaps. Prioritize further unopened source cards only when a specific material target is selected; keep the UCR chronology distinct from mapped original press reports.

description: Open-web discovery does not reproduce the original LexisNexis newspaper collection or equivalent systematic hemeroteca coverage; results do not establish exhaustive coverage.
required_followup: In the full first-pass report, state actual language, weekly, sector, and boundary queries and retain archive-access limitations.

description: The official current Mass Mobilization baseline, universe, and coding version remain pending at project level.
required_followup: Keep baseline_gate pending_official_baseline; coordinator resolves compatibility separately.

description: No reviewed source establishes whether any candidate gathering reached 50 people. UCR and the two Puerto Viejo reports give no count; “among their best” is not a defensible threshold basis. The 150 resident families at INDER and six hospital detainees are not protest-attendance counts. S046 identifies the Los Chiles/Los Llanos INDER action but its reviewed body notes preserve no crowd estimate. S044’s 12 youth belong to a separate training group, not the demonstration. S045 gives no count for either distinct Potrero or San José action.
required_followup: Review exact action reports and seek specific turnout evidence; retain threshold as unknown when only a qualitative phrase, household count, vehicles, affected persons, or detainee count is available.

description: The UCR chronology identifies the Heredia hospital action as opposition to vaccinating an admitted minor, but the exact participant demands and state-policy target need event-level reports. S018’s official statement could not be read after a pre-content 406 and pre-HTTP DNS failure.
required_followup: Review exact contemporary reports if a new body window is authorized; distinguish participants’ stated demands from third-party/official framing and code only supported own-government or policy targets.

description: Women’s safety episode boundaries remain unresolved: UCR lists a Jan 7 Puerto Viejo march and Jan 14 entry for women-led actions in Puerto Viejo and San José, while S004/S005 report one Jan 13 Puerto Viejo march. Separately, S044 reports the Bajo Chirripó anti-impunity demonstration on Jan 26 that likely corresponds to UCR’s Jan 27 entry; retain the body-reported action date and one event.
required_followup: Compare original reports for actual onset, location, organizers, demands and action linkage; preserve distinct locations or pending_unit where the evidence does not resolve a merge.

description: The UCR chronology is a secondary event index whose newspaper corpus is not mapped to individual entries. S004 and S005 report the same Jan 13 Puerto Viejo march. S044 is a distinct Semanario Universidad report of the Jan 26 courthouse action likely corresponding to UCR Jan 27. S045 distinguishes Potrero Jan 29 and San José Jan 30 actions. S046 is a Delfino report of Los Chiles families and the INDER land issue, likely related to UCR Jan 26, but its saved review does not establish an explicit action date or map it to the UCR newspaper corpus. S046 says the Partido de los Trabajadores accompanied families and sent press releases; no independent firsthand origin is established by that statement.
required_followup: Inspect exact pages and citations where accessible; record only explicit written-story origins, agency links, or documented source relationships, and do not count UCR synthesis or repeated reports as independent confirmations.

description: The UCR chronology reports a Jan 26 Heredia hospital incursion over vaccination of an admitted minor, altercations, police arrival and six detainees. S018’s official statement body was unavailable after HTTP 406 before content and a fallback DNS failure; later reports remain unread. The number detained is not the crowd size and does not establish state crowd dispersal.
required_followup: Use exact contemporaneous reports to distinguish the initial gathering from arrests, later vaccination and court/legislative follow-ups; code only actions explicitly attributed to the event.

description: A search result says a party applied for a January 30 piquete, but the gathering, participation, demands, and inclusion under the project’s partisan-support exclusion are unknown.
required_followup: Review the exact decision and seek an occurrence report; preserve the exclusion distinction for coordinator review.

description: Exact-source reads are documented for S001, S004, S005, S044, S045 and S046. S017 had a native pre-content cache miss and its one exact-URL no-cookie fallback failed at DNS before HTTP; S018 had a pre-content 406 and its one fallback failed at DNS. Neither is a publisher denial, and neither was retried. S046 had a native cache miss followed by one exact captured-URL no-cookie, no-redirect HTTPS GET returning 200; the body was read in memory, no copy was saved, and its metadata-only summary is in body_reads/. S044–S046 cards are synchronized to their saved reads and marked opened. Forty other cards remain unopened.
required_followup: Preserve S017/S018 as exhausted technical failures. Obtain independent review and retain the open date, turnout, meeting, outcome and story-origin questions. Prioritize further source reads only for specific material targets in an authorized later window.

description: The currency-depreciation march lead has no verified month or occurrence date in captured header metadata.
required_followup: Check publication and event dates if the body is accessible; retain only January onset events in this unit.

description: UCR reports a Jan 23 Southern Zone march against an ARESEP bus-fare increase, now retained as a UCR-only pending-threshold candidate. Targeted open-web searches did not surface a clearly matching contemporary press report, so turnout, exact route, original-story origin and relation to fare actions elsewhere remain unverified.
required_followup: Review exact matching local/regional reports in a later authorized body window; keep the candidate pending threshold and origin review until turnout and source lineage are evidenced.
